```{r}
# Load packages and functions from setup script
source(
  here::here(
    "3-scripts",
    "0-setup.r"
  )
)

pbs_sites <- get_wq_sites(study_area)

start_date <- "2005-01-01" # Beginning date of WQ data

end_date <- "2025-01-01" # Ending date of WQ data

force_toggle <- TRUE # TRUE or FALSE, determines if new API download occurs

bin = 2000
```

# Retrieve WQ data using study-area sites and selected parameters

## Chlorophyll-a

```{r}
# Retrieve Data 
chla_raw <- get_sf_wq_data(
  param = "Chlorophyll a, corrected for pheophytin",
  from_date = start_date,
  to_date = end_date,
  sites = pbs_sites,
  study_area = study_area,
  output_name = "chl_a_raw",
  force = TRUE
)

```

```{r}
# check that all units are same
table(chla_raw$Result_MeasureUnit)

# open outlier table to inspect data for extreme outliers
# view(find_outliers(chla_raw))

chla_raw <- chla_raw %>%
  #filter(Result_MeasureUnit != "" & Result_ResultDetectionCondition != "Not Detected" & Result_Measure < 100) %>%
  mutate(Result_Measure = as.numeric(Result_Measure))

```


```{r}
# Process Data
chla_proc <- proc_sf_wq_data(
  wq_data = chla_raw, 
  study_area = study_area,
  output_name = "chla_proc", 
  bin_size = bin) %>% 
    filter(total_n > 1)

# Plot Data Distribution
param_means_hist(chla_proc, "Chlorophyll-a (µg/L)")

# Plot Spatial Distribution
param_means_map(chla_proc, "Chlorophyll-a (µg/L)")

hist(chla_proc$mean)

#rm(chla_raw)


```

## Salinity

```{r}

salinity_raw <- get_sf_wq_data(
  param = "Salinity",
  from_date = start_date,
  to_date = end_date,
  study_area = study_area,
  sites = pbs_sites,
  output_name = "salinity_raw",
  force = TRUE # TODO: must be set to true if old data is in cache. 
)

```


Clean data before processing for interpolation
```{r}
# check units to make sure all are comparable
table(salinity_raw$Result_MeasureUnit)

view(find_outliers(salinity_raw))

# drop unwanted measurements 
salinity_raw <- salinity_raw %>%
  filter(Result_Measure != 2190 & Result_Measure != 322) # Drop extreme outliers

```

```{r}

# Process Data
sal_proc <- proc_sf_wq_data(
  wq_data = salinity_raw, 
  study_area = study_area, 
  output_name = "sal_proc",
  bin_size = bin)

sal_proc <- sal_proc %>% filter(total_n > 1)

# Plot Data Distribution
param_means_hist(sal_proc, "Salinity (ppt)")

# View Spatial Distribution
param_means_map(sal_proc, "Salinity (ppt)")

#rm(salinity_raw)
```


## Water Temperature

```{r}
water_temp_raw <- get_sf_wq_data(
  param = "Temperature, water",
  from_date = start_date,
  to_date = end_date,
  study_area = study_area,
  sites = pbs_sites,
  output_name = "water_temp_raw",
  force = force_toggle
)
```

### Clean Water Temp Data
```{r}
# check units
table(water_temp_raw$Result_MeasureUnit)

#view(find_outliers(water_temp_raw))

# remove extreme outliers
water_temp_raw <- water_temp_raw %>% filter(Result_Measure < 100)
```

### Run Processing Script 
```{r}
water_temp_proc <- proc_sf_wq_data(
  wq_data = water_temp_raw,
  study_area = study_area,
  output_name = "water_temp_proc", 
  bin_size = bin
  ) %>% 
    filter(
      total_n > 1
      )

# Plot Data Distribution
param_means_hist(water_temp_proc, "Water Temperature (°C)")

# View Spatial Distribution
param_means_map(water_temp_proc, "Water Temperature (°C)")

#rm(water_temp_raw)
```

```{r}
wq_summary <- bind_rows(
  sal_proc %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% mutate(parameter = "Salinity (ppt)"),
  do_proc %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% mutate(parameter = "Dissolved Oxygen (mg/L)"),
  chla_proc %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% mutate(parameter = "Chlorophyll-a (µg/L)"),
  turbidity_proc %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% mutate(parameter = "Turbidity (FTU)"),
  water_temp_proc %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% mutate(parameter = "Temperature (°C)")
)
```

Retrieve Oyster Data:

https://gis.myfwc.com/hosting/rest/services/Open_Data/Oyster_Beds_Statewide/MapServer/17/query?outFields=*&where=1%3D1&f=geojson

```{r}

oyster_reefs <- get_oyster_reefs()

tm_basemap("Esri.WorldGrayCanvas") +
    tm_shape(oyster_reefs, bbox = study_area) +
    tm_dots(
      col = "black",
      size = 0.5,
      lwd = 0.5,
      fill.legend = tm_legend(
        title = "PBS Oyster Reefs",
        title.fontface = 2,
        #position = c("left", "bottom"),
        position = tm_pos_out("center", "bottom", pos.h = "center"),
        orientation = "landscape",
        show = TRUE
      )
    ) +
    tm_shape(study_area, bbox = study_area) +
    tm_borders(
      col = "red"
    )
    tm_layout(
      inner.margins = c(0.2, 0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
    ) +
    tm_title("Oyster Beds in Pensacola Bay System", fontface = 2) +
    tm_compass(type = "8star")
```
